children: Q1 fiscal 2027 revenue rose 28.9% year over year to $60.1M, while net results shifted to a $0.9M loss from $0.3M earnings. Gross margin fell to 8.5% from 12.1%.

AI Analyst View
Revenue $60.1M, up 28.9% YoY
Strong activity growth, but higher revenue did not translate into higher gross profit.
Net loss $0.9M vs. $0.3M earnings
Results swung to a loss, with increased costs, interest expense and FX variation weighing on earnings.
Gross margin 8.5% vs. 12.1%
Margin compression highlights lower Canadian drilling productivity, inflation and higher depreciation.
Adjusted EBITDA $3.9M vs. $3.8M
Adjusted EBITDA edged higher despite the weaker gross margin; the release gives no percentage change.
Utilization 72% vs. 56%
Higher rig usage signals stronger demand, though training and cost pressures limited profitability.
New contract expected to exceed $100M over 5 years
The northern Canada contract offers a substantial revenue opportunity; positive earnings contribution is expected from fiscal H2.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a period of strong activity growth, but the quarter shows profitability lagging as the company invests in capacity and absorbs cost pressures. Investors will look for improving productivity, margins and the expected contract contribution in the second half of fiscal 2027.
